name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public
  inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  Wednesday, January 26, 2022, 6:30 p.m.

  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at carolk@wlv.org no later than
12:00 p.m. on Wednesday, January 26, 2022. Written comments will be summarized during the
  meeting.

Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Councilmembers and staff are participating in this
 meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e). In the interest of
maintaining appropriate social distancing, a physical location is not being provided for the public
  to attend or comment. Members of the public may observe the meeting telephonically or
 otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service, and may offer comment in real
  time, with the following steps:

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88444266369
  Or One tap mobile:
  US: +16699009128,,88444266369# or +13462487799,,88444266369#
  Or Telephone:
  Dial(for higher quality, dial a number based on your current location):
 US: +1 669 900 9128 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 301 715 8592 or +1 312
  626 6799 or +1 646 558 8656
  Webinar ID: 884 4426 6369
 Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers McSweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tem Pearl,
  Mayor Halpern

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:  Minutes of the January 12, 2022 City Council Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer
comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

  1.  Sheriff's Department Report

  2.  Fire Department Report

  3.  Chamber of Commerce Report

  4.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

  1.  TELECOMMUNICATIONS/CONNECTIVITY/IT COMMITTEE REPORT - Update
  on the Telecommunications/Connectivity/IT Committee meeting held on July 23, 2021, regarding
  the design revisions to the City’s website.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  1. CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 21-009; RESOLUTION NO. 2231-22 –
  Consideration of an application from Hamid Sadraie, on behalf of The Landing Grill and Sushi
  Bar, requesting approval of Conditional Use Permit No. 21-009, to authorize the sale of beer,
  wine, and distilled spirits and the use of a 1,250 sq. ft. outdoor dining area as part of the operation
  of the restaurant located at 32123 Lindero Canyon Road, Suite No. 109.
   2. PUBLIC HEARING FOR REALLOCATION OF FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 AND
  ALLOCATION OF FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM FUNDS AND CARES ACT FUNDS; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2232-22 – Consideration of the reallocation of funding for the 47th Year (Fiscal Year
  2021-22) Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program and CDBG-CV1 program
  funds; as well as to consider the proposed projects to be funded with the City's 48th Year (Fiscal
  Year 2022-23) CDBG program funds.

  MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

  1.  Engineering Department Report

  2.  Planning Department Report

  3.  Cultural Recreation Report

  CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine
  and will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there
  will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective January 15, 2022

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING SUBMITTAL OF APPLICATIONS FOR
  CALRECYCLE GRANTS AND PAYMENT PROGRAMS; RESOLUTION NO.
  2233-22 – Consideration of adopting Resolution No. 2233-22 titled ‘A Resolution of the City
  Council of the City of Westlake Village Authorizing Submittal of Applications for all CalRecycle
  Grant and Payment Programs for which the City of Westlake Village is Eligible.’

  2. APPROVAL OF RETAINER AGREEMENT FOR SPECIAL LAND USE
  COUNSEL FOR NORTH BUSINESS PARK SPECIFIC PLAN HOUSING
  PROJECTS – Consideration of an approval for the conflict waiver for, retainer agreement with
  Allen Matkins and a budget amendment not-to-exceed $100,000 for special land use counsel
  services for North Business Park Specific Plan housing projects, and that the City Manager be
  authorized to execute the same.

  OLD BUSINESS:

  NEW BUSINESS:

  ADJOURNMENT:
